**Allowed origins:** `http://localhost:4200`, any `*.pages.dev`, and any `*.workers.dev` subdomain.

**Where it's enforced:** `worker/src/index.ts`, inside the `cors()` middleware's `origin` callback (lines ~20–30). It checks `origin === 'http://localhost:4200' || origin.endsWith('.pages.dev') || origin.endsWith('.workers.dev')`, returning `null` (reject) otherwise.

**To add a new custom domain:** edit that same `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts` — add another condition, e.g. `origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com'` (or an `.endsWith(...)` check for a subdomain pattern), since Hono's `cors()` only supports exact-string matches in array form, not wildcards. Also update the comment/doc in `docs/code/worker/src/index.md` and `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` §4 (CORS) per the project's doc-authoring convention.
